description: This file defines a Java class 'DevOpsErrorResponse' which models the response to a DevOps command that contains information about an error, specifically wrapping a 'DittoRuntimeException'. It includes methods for creation from JSON, getters for technical fields, and overrides for common object methods.

classes.name: DevOpsErrorResponse
classes.description: An immutable class representing an error response for a DevOps command, encapsulating exception details and related metadata.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of DevOpsErrorResponse with specified parameters.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DevOpsErrorResponse from a JSON string or JSON object, including deserialization of the embedded exception.

methods.name: getDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Returns the JSON object representing the embedded DittoRuntimeException.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the service name associated with the error, if available.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the instance identifier, if available.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new DevOpsErrorResponse instance with the provided DittoHeaders.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new DevOpsErrorResponse with the specified JSON entity.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON object of the embedded exception.
